articles.summary: Emergencies and natural disasters can happen at any time, often when we least expect them. Being prepared for these unfortunate events is the best way to protect your home and keep your family safe.The Ready Campaign, launched in 2003, is a national public service initiative designed to promote preparedness in the face of natural and man-made disasters. Ready.gov provides a number of resources for Americans to stay informed, formulate an emergency plan, build an emergency kit, and set themselves up for success.
articles.title: September is National Preparedness Month: Are You Ready?
